children: UK sportswear retailer's half-year revenue declined 0.7% yr/yr amid challenging market
Adjusted basic EPS fell 13.7% yr/yr as operating profit and margins declined
Company raised interim dividend 21% and maintained FY27 profit guidance
JD Sports maintains FY27 profit before tax and adjusting items guidance of £700m-£800m
Company reiterates FY27 free cash flow guidance of £460m-£520m
Company expects challenging trading conditions to persist into H2
CONSUMER PRESSURES - Co said cost-of-living pressures and subdued consumer sentiment weighed on sales, especially in North America and Europe
FOOTWEAR CYCLE HEADWINDS - Softness in end-of-cycle footwear lines and a highly promotional market impacted sales and margins
APPAREL & ONLINE GROWTH - Apparel and accessories sales grew and online sales increased, supported by new e-commerce platforms and omni-channel investments
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", 11 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the apparel & accessories retailers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for JD Sports Fashion PLC is GBp95.00, about 20.7% above its September 22 closing price of GBp78.72
The stock recently traded at 7 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 7 three months ago
